result.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
result.summary: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. CTLink was trained on 4123 noncontrast chest CT scans with 9547 segmented report findings, including ReXGroundingCTv2, a newly annotated dataset of 1134 scans and 1895 findings with every instance of each finding segmented. On the 200 ReXGroundingCT validation scans, CTLink achieved a hit rate of 0.816, an instance F1 score of 0.456, and a mean Dice score of 0.400, compared with 0.533, 0.175, and 0.234 for VoxTell, a publicly available text-prompted segmentation model (P < .001 for all). On the test set of the MICCAI 2026 ReXGrounding challenge, an ensemble of seven CTLink models achieved the highest hit rate (0.782) and instance F1 score (0.386) of all 48 participating teams. On 50 test scans segmented twice by independent radiologists, CTLink matched or exceeded inter-rater agreement. Diffuse non-focal findings remained the main limitation, partly because their extent is outlined inconsistently even between radiologists. The CTLink model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/rajpurkarlab/CTLink, and the dataset at https://huggingface.co/datasets/rajpurkarlab/ReXGroundingCT.

AI.brief_summary: CTLink 是一个文本提示的 3D 胸部 CT 分割模型，按放射报告中的发现文本分割出对应病灶实例，并发布含 1134 例扫描的新标注数据集 ReXGroundingCTv2，在 ReXGrounding 验证集与挑战赛上报告命中率、实例 F1 与 Dice。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「报告文本—图像区域」实例级定位标注与放射科医生间一致性上限，可能可供核查 VLM 推理中视觉证据筛选的评价口径（尤其弥散性发现的定位歧义），但该工作本身是分割应用，不含 latent 推理状态或生成机制。
